points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite usually falls, so remaining level is the base high-probability branch.

points.rationale_en: Belgium wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or counterattacking efficiency.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加时只适用于90分钟打平后的条件分支，不能简单延续比利时常规时间42.3%胜率优势；进入加时后，比赛重心会转向体能、换人和点球入口管理。
key_factors.impact_en: Extra time applies only if it is level after 90 minutes; Belgium's 42.3% regular-time win edge should not simply carry over. Once in extra time, the focus shifts to fitness, substitutions, and managing the path to penalties.

key_factors.impact_cn: 比利时运动战创造力和门将/技术点仍略优，但上一轮120分钟负荷、德布劳内未踢满90分钟、卢卡库无法踢满90分钟，会压低加时持续打穿概率。
key_factors.impact_en: Belgium still have a slight edge in open-play creativity and goalkeeper/technical factors, but the 120-minute load last round, De Bruyne not playing a full 90, and Lukaku being unable to complete 90 minutes reduce the chance of sustained extra-time breakthrough.

key_factors.impact_cn: 美国上一轮90分钟晋级且少打一人守住结果，低位纪律与定位球入口更清晰；若90-105分钟保持结构完整，具备反击或拖入点球的窗口。
key_factors.impact_en: United States advanced in 90 minutes last round and held the result with one man down, showing clearer low-block discipline and set-piece routes; if they keep their structure intact from 90-105 minutes, they have a window to counter or force penalties.

key_factors.impact_cn: 比利时加时前的关键变量是德布劳内和卢卡库是否仍在场；若两人90分钟前已被消耗或换下，比利时加时创造力与终结质量会明显收缩。
key_factors.impact_en: Belgium's key pre-extra-time variable is whether De Bruyne and Lukaku are still on the pitch; if both are spent or subbed off before 90 minutes, Belgium's extra-time creativity and finishing quality drop sharply.
